actions.reason: K4_C0001 has an interpretable transcriptomic identity (broad down-regulated OXPHOS/immune program), but the exact-set membership-role conclusion is not positive: the native multimodal geometries are weak and mixed (CT silhouette -0.094 with all patients negative; RNA 0.018 and WSI 0.035 marginally positive with large negative fractions; only WXS modestly positive at 0.137), so current membership is not positively represented. The plausible structural alternative was the nominated neighbor pair K4_C0001|K4_C0004. Boundary representation for that pair is weak and mixed (CT slightly negative, RNA/WSI marginal, only WXS clearly positive), and the union structural diagnostics are conflicting: the current two-way boundary is represented (ARI=1.0, within 0.486 vs between 0.171) but the union is single-cluster dominated (candidate_k=1), which is merge-compatible rather than boundary-preserving. This conflicting pair evidence does not positively support removing the boundary, so no supported merge or split provides a better representation. With membership unsupported and no structural rescue established, retention of K4_C0001 as an independent unit is not justified.

K4_C0002 has an interpretable transcriptomic identity (up-regulated OXPHOS/protein-secretion/fatty-acid/mTORC1 program), but the exact-set membership-role conclusion is not positive: all four native geometries are negative (CT -0.024, RNA -0.074, WSI -0.075, WXS -0.074) with high negative fractions, so the set is closer to a competing set than to itself in every modality. The nominated neighbor pair K4_C0002|K4_C0003 was reviewed: boundary representation is weak (only CT clearly positive at 0.143; RNA/WSI/WXS marginal with high negative fractions), and the union structural diagnostics are broadly aligned with preserving the boundary (ARI=0.846, within 0.570 vs between 0.193, union candidate_k=2 aligned with the current two-way structure). That evidence supports retaining the boundary rather than merging, so no supported merge or split yields a better representation. With membership unsupported and no structural rescue established, retention of K4_C0002 as an independent unit is not justified.

K4_C0003 has an interpretable transcriptomic identity (up-regulated immune/inflammatory allograft-rejection/IFN/IL6-JAK-STAT3 program), but the exact-set membership-role conclusion is not positive: the native geometries conflict and are non-separating (CT 0.039 and RNA 0.125 positive, but WSI -0.063 and WXS -0.140 negative, with inconsistent nearest competitors), so current membership is not positively represented. The nominated neighbor pair K4_C0002|K4_C0003 was reviewed: boundary representation is weak, and the union structural diagnostics are broadly aligned with preserving the boundary (ARI=0.846, within 0.570 vs between 0.193, union candidate_k=2 aligned with the current two-way structure), which supports retaining the boundary rather than merging. No supported merge or split provides a better representation. With membership unsupported and no structural rescue established, retention of K4_C0003 as an independent unit is not justified.

K4_C0004 has an interpretable transcriptomic identity (up-regulated ECM/collagen, Hedgehog, mitotic-spindle, EMT, TGF-beta program), but the exact-set membership-role conclusion is not positive: the native geometries are mixed (WXS strongly positive at 0.811, but CT only 0.023 with substantial negative fraction and RNA -0.062 and WSI -0.025 slightly negative), so strong support in one modality does not override material disagreement in the others and current membership is not positively represented. The nominated neighbor pair K4_C0001|K4_C0004 was reviewed: boundary representation is weak and mixed, and the union structural diagnostics are conflicting (current boundary represented with ARI=1.0 and within 0.486 vs between 0.171, but union single-cluster dominated at candidate_k=1, which is merge-compatible rather than boundary-preserving). This conflicting pair evidence does not positively support removing the boundary, so no supported merge or split provides a better representation. With membership unsupported and no structural rescue established, retention of K4_C0004 as an independent unit is not justified.
